name: llmdungeon-ci-release-fixtures
description: Release-fixture CI checks for release-fixtures-test.yml (specs/023-cicd-pipeline-optimization): exercises semantic-release-monorepo's path-diff commit filtering combined with @semantic-release/commit-analyzer's bump-type logic against synthetic commits. Split out from scripts/workflow-checks (issue #192) so this heavier dependency tree doesn't burden the lightweight workflow-structure-test.yml job.
